gloss: to be enraptured; to be dead drunk

definitions.gloss: to be enraptured; to be intoxicated (by music, victory, etc.)
definitions.explanation: To be completely carried away by something delightful, such as music, beauty or success, so that nothing else matters. The common sense today, written with に: {勝利|しょうり}に{酔|よ}いしれる (to be drunk with victory).
To be thoroughly drunk on alcohol, so drunk one loses track of things. Less common than sense 1, and written rather than spoken.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{酔|よ}いしれた。
⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{歌声|うたごえ}→歌声：20116_utagoe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{酔|よ}いしれた。
examples.english: The audience was enraptured by the beautiful singing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧、⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧じゅう⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{酔|よ}いしれた。
examples.english: The night the championship was decided, fans all over town were swept away with joy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{酔|よ}いしれる。
examples.english: To be dead drunk on sake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}→一晩中：20338_hitobanjuu⟧{酔|よ}いしれて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He was blind drunk all night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧、⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{酔|よ}いしれて⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{歌|うた}い→歌う：00684_utau⟧{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: On the festival night the men got roaring drunk and sang until morning.

notes:
Also written {酔|よ}い{痴|し}れる. Built from ⟦{酔|よ}う→酔う：14437_you⟧ (to get drunk) + しれる (to lose one's senses). The cause takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{酔|よ}いしれる: to be drunk with victory
- ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{酔|よ}いしれる: to be lost in the music
- ⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{酔|よ}いしれる: to be overcome with joy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{酔|よ}う→酔う：14437_you⟧: to get drunk; to be moved — the plain verb, much weaker
- ⟦うっとりする→うっとりする：21633_uttorisuru⟧: to be entranced — softer, a dreamy feeling rather than total abandon
- ⟦{陶酔|とうすい}→陶酔：06001_tousui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be intoxicated, enraptured — formal

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {酔|よ}いしれていませんでした
